title: Silver rate today 27 November: MCX Price 6% upper circuit at  ₹1.54 lakh/kg, up  ₹8,500 in a day | Right time to buy? | Stock Market News
text:
Silver rate today 27 November 2026: Following weakness in the US Dollar (USD) and the Indian National Rupee (INR), the MCX silver rate today ascended to an intraday high of ₹1,54,804 per kg, hitting 6% upper circuit during the Friday session. In the international market, the COMEX silver price today saw strong bargain-hunting and touched an intraday high of $44.303 per ounce, logging a 10% rise in a single session. According to market experts, silver price today in India hit 6% upper circuit due to the bargain hunting after weakness in the Indian Rupee and the US Dollar. They said that the Indian Rupee nosedived 60 paise on Friday and closed at 92.98. They said that the USD also witnessed a retreat from the 19-month high, which triggered positive sentiment about bullion in the domestic and international markets. Speaking on the reasons that are fueling silver price today, Anuj Gupta, a SEBI-registered market expert, said, “Silver price today witnessed strong bargain hunting following weakness in the Indian and the US currencies. The USD has retreated from the 19-month high, whereas the Indian Rupee depreciated 60 paise to 92.98 at the end of Friday session.” Pointing towards the rebound in AI and other tech stocks, Kaynat Chainwala, AVP — Commodity Research at Kotak Neo, said, “Spot gold and silver are trading more than 3% and 6% higher, near $3,670/oz and $44.3/oz respectively, as a recovery in AI and other technology stocks and a softer US dollar have eased the liquidation pressure seen earlier this week. The rebound has helped the metals recover part of last week's sharp losses.” The Kotak Neo expert said that silver price rally may continue, but not for the longterm as the hawkish US Fed may cap silver price rally beyond $47.90 per ounce levels. “While prices could extend higher toward $3,750/oz for gold and $47.9/oz for silver, upside is likely to be capped as the macro backdrop remains challenging, with a hawkish Fed outlook and strong US data. Renewed volatility in tech stocks could also revive selling pressure on bullion, given how closely the recent weakness in both metals has been tied to broader portfolio liquidation. Until the rate outlook shifts, gains are therefore likely to remain a corrective rebound rather than the start of a sustained recovery,” Kaynat Chainwala of Kotak Neo said. Speaking on the outlook for the MCX silver rate today, Ponmudi R, CEO at Enrich Money, said, “On the upside, immediate resistance is placed at ₹1,56,000– ₹1,58,000, followed by ₹1,64,000– ₹1,66,000. On the lower side, ₹1,51,300 is new support, which needs to sustain for more upside in the precious white metal.” Anuj Gupta said the COMEX gold price today has broken above the $44 per ounce resistance, making a new support at $43.40/oz. So, today's close will be important, as sustaining above $43.40 levels means strong bains being intact. In such case, markets will wait for the US Job data coming on 4th December 2026 keeping the trading range of $43 to $48." The SEBI-registered market expert said that MCX silver is also expected to move in ₹1,45,000 to ₹1,58,000 per kg range, if the COMEX silver rate today ends above $43.40 per ounce.
